evals.prompt: Backtestea una estrategia de cruce de medias moviles (50/200) en BTC-USD diario, ultimo año, con slippage y fills realistas
evals.expected_output: Reporte con Sharpe, drawdown, win rate, expectancy, Monte Carlo y conclusion deploy/refine/abandon
expectations: Defines the strategy spec before running: entry/exit rules, slippage and fill assumption
Reports Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate and expectancy
Runs Monte Carlo and parameter sensitivity before the verdict
Ends with an explicit deploy, refine or abandon conclusion

evals.prompt: Prueba mi estrategia RSI-2 mean reversion en SPY con stops del 3%, quiero saber si es robusta o overfit
evals.expected_output: Backtest completo con sensibilidad de parametros y veredicto fundado
expectations: Uses a train/validation/test split or walk-forward, not a single in-sample run
Tests parameter sensitivity around the 3% stop
States whether the result looks overfit and names the evidence

evals.prompt: Simula una estrategia de breakout con ATR trailing stop en ETH, train/val/test split
evals.expected_output: Metricas por split, walk-forward y recomendacion de deploy o descarte
expectations: Reports metrics per split (train, validation, test)
Ties the deploy or discard recommendation to the out-of-sample result
